verdict.rationale: mParticle documents rule-like conditional behavior on incoming event data. Forwarding rules can block events from being sent downstream based on consent state, and audiences defined by criteria can be connected to outputs for activation. This is a narrow, privacy- and segmentation-focused form of event-driven automation rather than a general rules-to-actions engine. Missing for 10: a general-purpose event-triggered rule/action builder, documentation of arbitrary action types (webhooks, workflows) fired on event conditions, AI-native rule authoring tied to event triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
